=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:24077-24080 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_stall_judge_linked_pr_keeps_escalation` calls `_pr_json_base_is_target_merge "${issue_num}" "${pr_json}" "${_STALL_STANDALONE_DEFAULT_BRANCH}" "" "${is_managed}"` with an empty declared branch, and it sets is_managed only from local_id. Its sibling `_reconcile_standalone_merged_pr_issue` (lines 24109-24121) gets `_stall_nt_declared` from `orchestrate_lib.py extract-integration-branch` and also checks the managed label or body marker.
  WHY: A linked PR merged into the issue's declared integration branch is classified `merged_non_target_base`, so `escalate_human` is kept instead of `attempt_merge`. Sonnet adds that a wave PR merged into a different project branch can be wrongly accepted through managed_no_child_metadata. Severity disagreement: gemini, minimax, gpt and glm rated it MAJOR; sonnet rated it NIT (confidence 3), noting that `_check_merged_pr_guard` reconciles most standalone merged PRs first (lines 25937-25939, 25999-26001).
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5773-5778 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_close_sweep_check_triage_branch` is gated only on `[ "${_sweep_cand_bound}" = "true" ] && [ "${_sweep_triage_parsed}" != "true" ]`, not on `_sweep_is_triage`.
  WHY: On every poll, non-triage `ai:merged` / `ai:ready-to-merge` issues with a bound candidate log a misleading `CLOSE_MERGED_SWEEP issue=<n> triage_rule=skip reason=label`, which clutters the new diagnostic stream. Fix: add `&& [ "${_sweep_is_triage}" = "true" ]`. All reviewers rated it NIT.
- scripts/check_triage_resolution.py:665-711 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_tree_match` treats the `pulls/{pr}/files` response (`len(files) > MAX_FALLBACK_FILES` with 300 as the reject threshold) as the complete changed-file set and never compares it with the PR's `changed_files` count.
  WHY: Reviewers say the endpoint caps at 300 files, so a fix PR with more than 300 files could resolve with `content_check=tree_match` after checking only part of its files (fail-open). Severity disagreement: gemini and glm rated it MAJOR, minimax NIT. sonnet rejected it as invalid, saying `--paginate --slurp` returns up to 3000 files, so a 300-file response is the complete list.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5834-5848 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `sweep_partial_delivery_reason` branch (lines 5834-5837) runs `continue` before the `_close_sweep_check_triage_gate` call (lines 5845-5848), so a triage issue with a partial-delivery candidate is never gated.
  WHY: Such issues stay open and keep using up stall-judge rounds even when the failure is already green on the default branch. Severity disagreement: gemini MAJOR, glm NIT. sonnet, minimax and gpt raised the same point as a task gap.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:24235-24317 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The source-PR-closed "not planned" close in `_close_sweep_check_triage_gate` never checks the source PR's head. It assumes "its failing code never reached the default branch".
  WHY: Integration PRs (`orchestrator/project-*` heads) are routinely closed and re-issued, for example project #739 through re-issue PR #753. The same content can therefore have reached the default branch, and a real, possibly still-red failure gets dropped. Suggested fix: hold the close with `triage_rule=skip reason=source_pr_integration_head`. Both reviewers rated it NIT.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:24294-24301 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_close_sweep_check_triage_gate` runs `gh_retry gh issue edit --add-label "ai:closed"` before `gh_retry gh issue close --reason "not planned" --comment`, and it does not check for an existing `<!-- ai:check-triage-source-closed:v1 ... -->` marker first.
  WHY: If the close fails, the issue stays open with the terminal ai:closed label. Each retry or tick posts another copy of the closing comment, and the log shows only `reason=close_failed`. All three reviewers rated it NIT.
- scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:1867-1908 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The new base-filter keyword arguments on `_linked_pr_evidence`, `evaluate_phase_failure_resume` (line 1922/1927) and `resolve_label_repair_evidence` (lines 2128-2142) have no production callers; only tests reach them.
  WHY: agents.d/9481-check-triage-close-gaps.md and the changelog present this as part of the AD-3 fix, but the filter that actually runs is the shell `_stall_judge_linked_pr_keeps_escalation`, which misleads maintainers. All three reviewers rated it NIT.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5647 (also scripts/check_triage_resolution.py:571; README.md:2756) | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: `CHECK_TRIAGE_GATE_SWEEP_MAX_PER_TICK` and `CHECK_TRIAGE_INTEGRATION_FALLBACK_ENABLED` are documented operator controls but are not forwarded from repository vars. Only CHECK_TRIAGE_RESOLVED_GATE_ENABLED is mapped, at orchestrate_poll.yml:1482,1676, clarify.yml:726, plan.yml:1185 and unblock_judge.yml:174.
  WHY: Setting either repository variable has no effect: the cap stays 10 and the fallback stays on at all four gate call sites. Sonnet suggests rewording README and agents fragment as job-environment-only, because .github/workflows is outside the plan grant. Both reviewers rated it NIT.
- scripts/check_triage_resolution.py:1167-1177 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The sweep runs the gate without --dry-run on every open ai:check-triage issue. On an unverified verdict, `fetch_failing_tracebacks` (lines 963-972) downloads up to 3 job logs, silently `continue`s on failure, and posts traceback comments from the poller in any phase.
  WHY: Expired logs are retried forever, at up to 30 extra calls per tick, which the §14 budget note does not cover. Traceback comments also land on issues in ai:implementing, ai:done or ai:blocked. Suggested fix: a `--no-traceback` flag passed only by `_close_sweep_check_triage_gate`.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:24298 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `gh issue close --comment` may be unsupported in older GitHub CLI versions.
  WHY: On such versions the close fails and the issue stays open with `reason=close_failed`. sonnet rejected this as invalid, saying hosted runners ship a gh that supports it.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py, tests/test_orchestrate_lib.py, tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py, tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py, tests/test_session_start_extract_repo_slug.py | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The pre-push gate attributes failures in four test files to this change, which static review cannot map to any diff hunk. All new poller tests in test_orchestrate_poll_process.py timed out.
  WHY: Either the gate's attribution is wrong or there is a regression static review cannot see; either way the PR's behavior is unverified until the failing files and the six new poller tests are run. sonnet's rejected list notes the timeout attribution is not a code defect.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "In the poll, run check_triage_resolution.py gate over open ai:check-triage issues in any phase (including ai:blocked, ai:needs-human, and never-started), and close them when the result is resolved / already_resolved."
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh close_merged_issues_sweep (partial-delivery early exit, before the gate-call block)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The `sweep_partial_delivery_reason` branch at lines 5834-5838 runs `continue` before the gate call at lines 5845-5852, so triage issues with a partial-delivery PR or identity_unavailable are never gated. No test covers this shape. Sonnet notes it may be intentional (issue_pr_status restarts clarify) but should then be documented as an exclusion.
- requirement: CHECK_TRIAGE_GATE_SWEEP_MAX_PER_TICK supports a configurable default of 10, with 0 disabling the sweep.
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml, the poller step's environment mapping (lines 1482 and 1676 area), or a README wording fix scoping it to process env only
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: `grep -n "CHECK_TRIAGE_GATE_SWEEP_MAX_PER_TICK" .github/workflows/` returns no matches. The poller reads it from the process environment only (orchestrate_poll_process.sh line 5647) and falls back to 10, so the repository variable has no effect.
- requirement: CHECK_TRIAGE_INTEGRATION_FALLBACK_ENABLED defaults to true and can be set to false to restore integration_pr_missing.
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml (lines 1482 and 1676 area, poller and standalone-recovery steps) and .github/workflows/clarify.yml, plan.yml, unblock_judge.yml
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: `grep -n "CHECK_TRIAGE_INTEGRATION_FALLBACK_ENABLED" .github/workflows/` returns no matches. The Python gate reads it from the process environment only (check_triage_resolution.py line ~571), so setting it to false does not disable the fallback at any of the four gate call sites.
- requirement: The pre-push gate reports multiple failures in new and existing tests, meaning the PR is currently untested and potentially broken.
  expected_change_site: tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py, tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py, tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py, tests/test_orchestrate_lib.py, tests/test_session_start_extract_repo_slug.py
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The pre-push gate reported timeouts and failures in these test suites. The editor must run them and resolve the failures before the change counts as verified (rated BLOCKER).
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:24077-24080 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `_pr_json_base_is_target_merge "${issue_num}" "${pr_json}" "${_STALL_STANDALONE_DEFAULT_BRANCH}" "" "${is_managed}"` always passes an empty declared branch. is_managed comes only from local_id (caller invoke_stall_judge lines 22497-22502), unlike _reconcile_standalone_merged_pr_issue (lines 24110-24121), which uses extract-integration-branch plus the label or body marker.
  WHY: (a) A wave PR merged into orchestrator/project-5 while the issue declares project-6 is accepted, so escalate_human is overridden to attempt_merge. (b) A declared-branch issue with no local_id is wrongly sent to ai:needs-human. Impact is limited by _check_merged_pr_guard (lines 25937-25939, 25999-26001).
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:_close_sweep_check_triage_gate (source-closed branch) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
